source=Path("/home/mekashirskiy/projection-transport-steering/tmp/irc-baseline-v3")

config_path=source/"research/irc-baseline-config-v3.json"

capture=base/f"selection-capture-{tag}"

assert not capture.exists() and not archive.exists() and not inventory_path.exists()

    assert info["Id"]==cid and info["Image"]==config["runtime_identity"]["image"]
    assert state["Status"]=="exited" and state["ExitCode"]==0 and not any(state[k] for k in ("Running","Paused","Restarting","OOMKilled","Dead","Error"))
    assert info["RestartCount"]==0
    argv=launch["launches"][index]["command"]
    assert info["Config"]["Entrypoint"]==["timeout"] and info["Config"]["Cmd"]==argv[argv.index(config["runtime_identity"]["image"])+1:]
    assert info["Config"]["User"]=="11027:11027" and info["HostConfig"]["NetworkMode"]=="none"
    assert info["HostConfig"]["DeviceRequests"][0]["DeviceIDs"]==[str(launch["launches"][index]["gpu"])]
    assert all(not m["RW"] for m in info["Mounts"] if m["Destination"] in ("/work","/model","/ptsenv","/overlay"))
    initial=json.loads((base/f"fit-capture-v1/candidate_{index:02d}-inspect.json").read_text())
    assert info["State"]["StartedAt"]==initial["State"]["StartedAt"] and info["Config"]==initial["Config"] and info["Mounts"]==initial["Mounts"] and info["HostConfig"]==initial["HostConfig"]
    seconds=(datetime.fromisoformat(state["FinishedAt"])-datetime.fromisoformat(state["StartedAt"])).total_seconds()
    assert 0<seconds<=18000
    directory=base/f"candidate_{index:02d}/run"

    assert receipt["status"]=="pass" and receipt["candidate"]==config["candidates"][index]
    logs=subprocess.run(["sudo","-n","docker","logs",cid],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=20)
    events=[json.loads(line) for line in logs.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("{")]
    assert [e for e in events if e.get("event")=="baseline_terminal"]==[{"event":"baseline_terminal","status":"pass"}]
    assert [e["completed"] for e in events if e.get("event")=="selection_chunk" and e.get("condition")=="selection"]==list(range(8,257,8))
    paths=sorted((directory/"selection").iterdir())+[directory/"receipt.json"]
    assert {p.name for p in paths[:-1]}=={f"{kind}-{start:04d}.json" for kind in ("batch","reference") for start in range(0,256,8)}
    for path in paths:
        fresh_files[str(path.relative_to(base))]=sha(path)
    for part,evidence in (("",prior_fit["workers"][index]["fit"]),("zero/",prior_zero["workers"][index]["audit"])):
        for name,digest in evidence["file_sha256"].items():
            path=directory/(part+name)
            assert sha(path)==digest
            reused_files[str(path.relative_to(base))]=digest
    observations.append({**record,"state":state,"restarts":info["RestartCount"],"container_seconds":seconds,"selection_completed":256,"actual_argv_env_mounts_match":True,"final_producer_receipt_present":True})
    streams[f"candidate_{index:02d}-inspect.json"]=json.dumps(info,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n"
    streams[f"candidate_{index:02d}-stdout.log"]=logs.stdout
    streams[f"candidate_{index:02d}-stderr.log"]=logs.stderr

for name,content in streams.items():
    with (capture/name).open("x") as handle:
        handle.write(content)
inventory=[]
with tarfile.open(archive,"x") as handle:
    for path in [base/name for name in sorted(fresh_files)]+sorted(capture.iterdir()):
        content=path.read_bytes()
        relative=str(path.relative_to(base))
        digest=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
        assert relative not in fresh_files or digest==fresh_files[relative]
        inventory.append({"path":relative,"bytes":len(content),"sha256":digest})
        handle.add(path,arcname=relative,recursive=False)
for name,digest in {**fresh_files,**reused_files}.items():
    assert sha(base/name)==digest
with inventory_path.open("x") as handle:
    for row in inventory:
        handle.write(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS_COMPLETE_SELECTION_CAPTURE_ONLY","timestamp":manifest["timestamp"],"indices":indices,"archive":str(archive),"archive_bytes":archive.stat().st_size,"archive_sha256":sha(archive),"inventory":str(inventory_path),"inventory_sha256":sha(inventory_path),"files":len(inventory),"manifest_sha256":sha(capture/"selection-input-manifest.json"),"workers":observations}),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
started=time.perf_counter()
tag=sys.argv[1]
report={"schema":"irc-baseline-v3-complete-selection-component-audit","status":"blocked","GPU":False,"model_or_adapter_weights_loaded":False,"zero_regraded":False,"fit_coverage_replayed":False,"complete_candidate_comparison":False,"response_launch_authorized":False,"sota_achieved":False,"workers":[]}

try:
    import torch
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    import analyze_irc_baseline,audit_irc_sources,irc_baseline_audit,irc_baseline_support

    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    assert not torch.cuda.is_available()
    root=Path("/work")
    base=Path("/results")
    config_path=root/"research/irc-baseline-config-v3.json"
    assert file_sha256(config_path)=="61529de3e7cf2e865d147ca11e54388590bb50e12d8702c388adb2ed7702f7be"
    config=json.loads(config_path.read_text())
    capture_path=base/f"selection-capture-{tag}/selection-input-manifest.json"

    modules={irc_baseline_audit:"74f446d955d48097ff68b451f0e13ffc9cd3db66280527761417ebcfb9c376ce",analyze_irc_baseline:"797e32fa1489832ae161f51ebbe33696e3426a66fb237a0e2f54bee35db7d1a3"}
    for module,digest in modules.items():
        assert file_sha256(Path(module.__file__))==digest,module.__file__
    for name,digest in config["source_sha256"].items():
        assert file_sha256(root/name)==digest,name
    versions={name:importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in config["expected_versions"]}
    assert versions==config["expected_versions"]
    model=Path(config["model_path"])
    for name,digest in config["model_files_sha256"].items():
        assert file_sha256(model/name)==digest,name
    assert capture["reused_audits_sha256"]=={"fit-audit-v1/result.json":"79f9fed0f91da13de053a8e74caf7d287d8d6b79506aac6f7564f5c69deca267","zero-audit-v1/result.json":"14e1bc01402e39ff25a90fd160e0cd2606add34ff38a1cce992cc203ca8000ac"}
    inputs={**capture["reused_audits_sha256"],**capture["raw_files_sha256"],**capture["reused_files_sha256"]}
    for name,digest in inputs.items():
        assert file_sha256(base/name)==digest,name
    prior_fit=json.loads((base/"fit-audit-v1/result.json").read_text())
    prior_zero=json.loads((base/"zero-audit-v1/result.json").read_text())
    assert prior_fit["status"]=="pass_complete_fit_component_only" and prior_zero["status"]=="pass_zero_component_only"
    sources=irc_baseline_support.checked_packet(root,config["selection"],"selection")
    assert len(sources)==256 and len({r["cluster_id"] for r in sources})==256
    tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model,local_files_only=True)
    generation_config={**config,"vocab_size":json.loads((model/"config.json").read_text())["vocab_size"]}
    extract,equivalent=audit_irc_sources.load_math_author(root)
    boxed=runpy.run_path(str(root/".external/math-author-source/modeling/dataset/util.py"))["last_boxed_only_string"]
    report.update(config_sha256=file_sha256(config_path),capture_sha256=file_sha256(capture_path),versions=versions,source_sha256=config["source_sha256"],analysis_source_sha256={m.__name__:d for m,d in modules.items()},reuse_audit_sha256=capture["reused_audits_sha256"],indices=capture["indices"])
    for observation in capture["workers"]:
        index=observation["index"]
        directory=base/f"candidate_{index:02d}/run"
        receipt=json.loads((directory/"receipt.json").read_text())
        assert receipt["status"]=="pass" and receipt["candidate"]==config["candidates"][index]
        assert receipt["config_sha256"]==file_sha256(config_path) and receipt["source_sha256"]==config["source_sha256"]
        assert receipt["scientific_role"]=="exploratory_baseline_selection"
        assert receipt["positive_action_admitted"]is False and receipt["training_resume_supported"]is False and receipt["base_parameter_versions_unchanged"]is True
        runner_seconds=receipt["total_elapsed_seconds"]
        assert math.isfinite(runner_seconds) and 0<runner_seconds<=observation["container_seconds"]+1<=18001
        old=prior_fit["workers"][index]
        assert old["index"]==index and old["candidate"]==receipt["candidate"]
        assert {k:v for k,v in receipt["fit"].items() if k!="seconds"}=={k:v for k,v in old["expected_input"].items() if k!="seconds"}
        measured=receipt["fit"]["seconds"]
        assert math.isfinite(measured) and sum(e["update_seconds"] for e in old["fit"]["epochs"])<=measured<=old["fit"]["fit_duration_upper_bound_seconds"]
        fit={k:v for k,v in old["fit"].items() if k not in ("fit_duration_upper_bound_seconds","measured_fit_duration_seconds")}
        fit["fit_seconds"]=measured
        zero=prior_zero["workers"][index]
        assert zero["index"]==index
        assert receipt["zero"]["completed_ids"]==[sources[i]["cluster_id"] for i in config["zero_shares"][index]]
        assert receipt["zero"]["chunk_sha256"]=={n:d for n,d in zero["audit"]["file_sha256"].items() if n.startswith("batch-")}
        rows,evidence=irc_baseline_audit.audit_condition(directory/"selection",sources,generation_config,receipt["selection"],tokenizer,(extract,equivalent,boxed))
        report["workers"].append({"index":index,"candidate":receipt["candidate"],"receipt_sha256":file_sha256(directory/"receipt.json"),"fit":fit,"zero":zero["audit"],"selection":evidence,"summary":analyze_irc_baseline.condition_summary(rows),"runner_seconds":runner_seconds,"container_seconds":observation["container_seconds"],"component_cost":irc_baseline_audit.audit_component_cost(fit,zero["audit"],evidence,runner_seconds),"base_parameter_versions_unchanged":True,"reused_fit_zero_producer_joins":True})
        print(json.dumps({"event":"complete_candidate_audited","index":index,"questions":len(rows),"producer_and_prior_audit_joins":True}),flush=True)
    assert [w["index"] for w in report["workers"]]==capture["indices"]
    for name,digest in inputs.items():
        assert file_sha256(base/name)==digest,name
    report.update(status="pass_complete_selection_components_only",grader_policy="Original primary and fixed-support sensitivity replayed once per new completed condition; stored scores never replaced",limits=["No partial-condition comparison, winner or next GPU stage admission.","Zero scores and complete fit/checkpoint audits reused by exact hashes; no model forward, checkpoint load or unchanged tests.","Actual fit/runner timings are nested in original terminal container lifetimes; no double charge.","Original all8 paired comparison and strict total v3 budget audit remain required."])
except BaseException as error:
    failure=error
    report["failure"]={"type":type(error).__name__,"message":str(error)}
report["CPU_audit_seconds"]=time.perf_counter()-started
with Path("/out/result.json").open("x") as handle:
    json.dump(report,handle,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
    handle.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"event":"selection_component_audit_terminal","status":report["status"],"CPU_seconds":report["CPU_audit_seconds"],"indices":[w["index"] for w in report["workers"]],"failure":report.get("failure")}),flush=True)
if failure is not None:
    raise SystemExit(1)
